$comment: Documented exceptions to the dependency vulnerability policy (docs/security/dependency-policy.md). Each entry needs the exact dependency paths reported by `pnpm audit`, a reason, a removal condition and a review date. Checked by `pnpm audit:check`.

exceptions.reason: Loaded only for MySQL datasources; our datasource is PostgreSQL, so the module is never imported. Exploiting it requires connecting to a malicious MySQL server.
exceptions.removeWhen: A stable Prisma release depends on mysql2 >= 3.22.0.

exceptions.reason: Needs a compressed MySQL protocol connection, which the project never opens (PostgreSQL only).
exceptions.removeWhen: A stable Prisma release depends on mysql2 >= 3.23.1.

exceptions.reason: Only merges layers of our own prisma7.config.ts (remote and RC configs disabled). The input is a repository file without recursive objects.
exceptions.removeWhen: A stable Prisma release depends on deepmerge-ts >= 8.

exceptions.reason: Runs only while linting, on glob patterns written in this repository; no untrusted input reaches it. No patched version exists yet.
exceptions.removeWhen: A patched braces release exists (then update or override), or the plugin stops depending on it.
